For all Leg raises, focus on crunching your pelvis and rounding your back (as if someone punched your stomach). Your chest should feel like its curving towards your belly button if that make sense.

Hi Booba, good luck with these. 

IG Vid on how to Target Glutes (skip to half of Video): https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVVilXbDfz9/?igsh=MWc2Z2g4dnVndzJwaQ==
Step ups for Knee. You had this in your notes next to calf raises.

1st set is Warm Up
2nd & 3rd are working sets
Depending on if you want to target your upper back do Inverted Rows and these can be superset while you're at the racks, or do Seated cable rows with your elbows at your sides to hit your lats.
Crunch Your Rib Cage Booba

Knees over Toes!
1st Set is Warm up (higher reps) Do with Dumbbells if necessary
2nd & 3rd are working sets
Crunch your Rib Cage Booba
Hi booba, make sure the path of the bar is vertical, don't rock too much with the weight, and bring your elbows straight down.
For all Leg raises, focus on crunching your pelvis and rounding your back (as if someone punched your stomach). Your chest should feel like its curving towards your belly button if that make sense.
